parsed.rationale: Both `StringCache` and `IntCache` in the `Caching` package share four fields identically (`capacity:Int`, `hitCount:UInt64`, `lastAccess:Date?`) and differ only in the key type of `storage` — `[String: CacheEntry]` vs `[Int: CacheEntry]`. This is the canonical PAT signal: a single varying slot whose type is the natural associated type. Introducing a `CacheProtocol` with `associatedtype Key: Hashable` and a `storage: [Key: CacheEntry]` requirement, plus default implementations for the invariant fields, eliminates the duplication while preserving full type safety. Neither record carries any restraint marker (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are all false), so the refactor is safe to proceed.
